info.name: FixMyText Backend API
info.description:
Public HTTP endpoints for all four FixMyText microservices (account-svc, ai-svc, payments-svc, text-svc), reached through the Kong gateway at {{base_url}}.

## Getting started
1. Set the `username` / `password` collection variables (a Keycloak user in the {{kc_realm}} realm).
2. Run **Auth - Keycloak / Get Token (password grant)**. Its test script stores `access_token` automatically.
3. Every protected request inherits collection-level Bearer auth using `{{access_token}}` - no manual paste needed.

## Topology
The individual services only expose port 8000 internally. Kong is the sole host-published entry point (127.0.0.1:8000:8000) and uses strip_path=false, so the external path equals the path the service sees. Direct per-service ports are NOT reachable from the host - always go through {{base_url}}.

Auth model: Keycloak-issued RS256 JWT in `Authorization: Bearer`. account-svc also accepts an HttpOnly session cookie; text-svc auth is optional (anonymous = visitor quota).

exec: // Collection-level harvester: runs AFTER every request in the collection.
// It scans the JSON response for well-known fields and seeds them into
// collection variables so values captured by one request auto-populate
// every other request. Per-request scripts (below) handle resource-specific
// ids; this handles the cross-cutting ones (tokens, identity, orders).
if (val === undefined || val === null || val === '') { return; }
// OAuth tokens (from any Keycloak token/refresh response)

item.name: 0. Auth - Keycloak
item.description: Obtain a JWT from Keycloak. These requests use No Auth (the token does not exist yet). The password-grant test script populates {{access_token}} and {{refresh_token}}.

request.description: Resource Owner Password Credentials grant. Requires the Keycloak client to permit direct access grants. On success, saves access_token and refresh_token to collection variables.

item.name: 1. account-svc
item.description: User accounts, profile, preferences, gamification, templates, history, sharing. Base prefix /api/v1. Accepts Bearer JWT or the fixmytext_session cookie.

request.description: Returns the current user profile and issues the fixmytext_session cookie. Auth required.

exec: // Registration does NOT return a token - it creates a Keycloak user
// and sends a verification email. So we capture the email/password
// you just submitted into the username/password variables, ready for
// the next step: run 'Get Token (password grant)' to obtain the JWT.
console.log('[register] seeded username/password for Get Token. Verify email first if the realm requires it.');
} catch (e) { console.log('[register] could not parse body: ' + e); }

request.description:
Self-registration into Keycloak. No auth. Per-IP throttled (default 10/hour). 201 on success.

If the realm enforces email verification, verify before the password grant will succeed.

item.name: 2. ai-svc
item.description:
AI text transformations via Groq. Base prefix /api/v1/ai. Requires verified Keycloak JWT (email must be verified for execution endpoints). Per-user rate limited (default 25/60s) and entitlement-gated via payments-svc.

Set {{ai_tool_id}} to the desired tool (e.g. summarize, translate, change-tone, change-format, paraphrase, grammar-fix).

request.description: Default body shape (TextRequest). Returns { original, result, operation }.

response.name: change-tone (ToneRequest)

request.description: Server-Sent Events, one token per line, terminated by [DONE]. Postman shows the raw stream body.

exec: if (pm.response.code === 201 || pm.response.code === 200) { const d = pm.response.json(); if (d.job_id) pm.collectionVariables.set('job_id', d.job_id); }

request.description: Queues a job via the arq worker. Returns { job_id, status:'queued' } and saves {{job_id}}. Poll with the next request.
Status one of queued|in_progress|complete|failed|not_found. 403 if the job belongs to another user.

item.name: 3. payments-svc
item.description: Billing: passes, credits, subscriptions, referrals, Razorpay. Base prefix /api/v1. Most endpoints require Bearer JWT; catalog and webhook are unauthenticated. The internal /internal/v1/check-access endpoint is service-to-service only and intentionally NOT included.

query.description: Optional; auto-detected from IP if omitted

request.description: Available passes and credit packs with regional pricing. No auth.
Creates a Razorpay order for a pass. Rate limited (10/min). Returns Razorpay order details.
item_type is 'pass' or 'credit'. Idempotent; verifies signature and grants entitlement.
Weekly reward wheel. Returns reward_type and amount/pass.
Uses {{referral_code}} - auto-populated by 'Get referral code'. Note: claiming your own code is rejected server-side; paste another user's code into the referral_code variable to test.
Tier, daily usage, credit balance, region. Records daily login bonus.
Creates a Razorpay order for Pro. Rate limited (10/min). Fails if already Pro.
Immediate downgrade.
Called by Razorpay. No bearer auth; guarded by x-razorpay-signature. Idempotent (deduped by event id), max 64KB payload. Handles payment.captured/authorized/failed, subscription.cancelled/halted.

item.name: 4. text-svc
item.description:
Local (non-AI) text transformations. Base prefix /api/v1/text. Every tool uses POST /api/v1/text/{tool_id} and returns { original, result, operation }.

Auth is OPTIONAL: Bearer works, and anonymous calls also succeed (visitor quota, keyed by IP). Rate limited via Redis; 5s wall-clock timeout per request.

Valid tool_id values (70+), by category:
- Case: uppercase, lowercase, inversecase, sentencecase, titlecase, upper-camel-case, lower-camel-case, snake-case, kebab-case, capitalize-words, alternating-case, inverse-word-case, wide-text, small-caps, upside-down, strikethrough, ap-title-case, swap-word-case, dot-case, constant-case, train-case, path-case, flat-case, cobol-case
- Whitespace/cleanup: remove-extra-spaces, remove-all-spaces, remove-line-breaks, strip-html, remove-accents, toggle-smart-quotes, strip-invisible, strip-emoji, normalize-whitespace, strip-non-ascii, fix-line-endings, strip-markdown, trim-lines, strip-empty-lines, strip-urls, strip-emails, normalize-punctuation, strip-numbers
- Encoding: base64-encode/decode, url-encode/decode, hex-encode/decode, morse-encode/decode, binary-encode/decode, octal-encode/decode, decimal-encode/decode, unicode-escape/unescape, base32-encode/decode, ascii85-encode/decode, brainfuck-encode/decode
- Ciphers: atbash, caesar-cipher, caesar-brute-force, vigenere-encrypt/decrypt, rail-fence-encrypt/decrypt, playfair-encrypt, substitution-cipher, columnar-transposition, nato-phonetic, bacon-cipher, rot13
- Line ops: reverse, sort-lines-asc/desc, remove-duplicate-lines, reverse-lines, number-lines, shuffle-lines, sort-by-length, sort-numeric, line-frequency, split-to-lines, join-lines, pad-lines, wrap-lines, filter-lines, remove-lines, truncate-lines, extract-nth-lines
- Dev tools: format-json, json-to-yaml, json-escape/unescape, html-escape/unescape, csv-to-json, json-to-csv, xml-to-json, csv-to-table, sql-insert-gen

Most tools take TextRequest {text}. The examples below cover every distinct request shape.

variable.description: Any valid local tool id (see folder description)

request.description: Generic entry point. Set the :tool_id path variable to any tool from the catalog. Default body is TextRequest {text}; some tools need extra fields - see the example requests.
shift: integer 1-25.
Same body shape (text, key) for vigenere-decrypt, playfair-encrypt, columnar-transposition.
rails: integer 2-10. Same shape for rail-fence-decrypt.
mapping: exactly 26 characters (a-z substitution alphabet).
Same shape (text, delimiter) for join-lines.
align: left | right | center.
max_length: integer 5-1000.
Dev tools (format-json, json-to-yaml, csv-to-json, etc.) all take TextRequest {text} where text is the source document as a string.

item.name: 5. Health
item.description: Liveness/readiness probes. The gateway routes /health to account-svc.
